types.explanation: Informational: Continue. The server has received the request headers and the client should proceed to send the request body.
Informational: Switching Protocols. The server agrees to switch protocols as requested by the client via the Upgrade header.
Success: OK. The request has succeeded and the response contains the requested resource.
Success: Created. The request has been fulfilled and a new resource has been created.
Success: Accepted. The request has been accepted for processing, but processing is not complete.
Success: Non-Authoritative Information. The returned metainformation is from a third-party copy, not the origin server.
Success: No Content. The server has fulfilled the request and there is no additional content to send.
Success: Reset Content. The server has fulfilled the request and the user agent should reset the document view.
Success: Partial Content. The server is delivering only part of the resource due to a range request.
Redirection: Multiple Choices. The target resource has more than one representation, each with its own URI.
Redirection: Moved Permanently. The target resource has been assigned a new permanent URI.
Redirection: Found. The target resource resides temporarily under a different URI.
Redirection: See Other. The response can be retrieved at a different URI using GET.
Redirection: Not Modified. The resource has not been modified since the conditional request; cache can use stored copy.
Redirection: Use Proxy. The requested resource must be accessed through the proxy given by the Location field.
Redirection: (Unused). This status code is no longer used.
Redirection: Temporary Redirect. The target resource resides temporarily under a different URI, method must not change.
Redirection: Permanent Redirect. The target resource has been assigned a new permanent URI, method must not change.
Client Error: Bad Request. The request could not be understood due to malformed syntax.
Client Error: Unauthorized. The request requires user authentication.
Client Error: Payment Required. Reserved for future use.
Client Error: Forbidden. The server understood the request but refuses to fulfill it.
Client Error: Not Found. The server has not found anything matching the Request-URI.
Client Error: Method Not Allowed. The method specified in the request is not allowed for the resource.
Client Error: Not Acceptable. The resource is capable of generating only responses with content characteristics not acceptable according to the accept headers sent.
Client Error: Proxy Authentication Required. The client must authenticate itself with the proxy.
Client Error: Request Timeout. The client did not produce a request within the time that the server was prepared to wait.
Client Error: Conflict. The request could not be completed due to a conflict with the current state of the resource.
Client Error: Gone. The requested resource is no longer available and no forwarding address is known.
Client Error: Length Required. The server refuses to accept the request without a defined Content-Length.
Client Error: Precondition Failed. One or more conditions given in the request header fields evaluated to false.
Client Error: Content Too Large. The request content is larger than the server is willing or able to process.
Client Error: URI Too Long. The Request-URI is longer than the server is willing to interpret.
Client Error: Unsupported Media Type. The request entity has a media type not supported by the resource.
Client Error: Range Not Satisfiable. The set of ranges in the request's Range header field cannot be satisfied.
Client Error: Expectation Failed. The server cannot meet the requirements of the Expect request-header field.
Client Error: (Unused) – I'm a teapot (RFC 2324). This code is defined for humorous purposes.
Client Error: Misdirected Request. The request was directed at a server that is not able to produce a response.
Client Error: Unprocessable Content. The server understands the content type but cannot process the instructions.
Client Error: Upgrade Required. The server refuses to perform the request using the current protocol but might be willing after upgrade.
Server Error: Internal Server Error. The server encountered an unexpected condition that prevented it from fulfilling the request.
Server Error: Not Implemented. The server does not support the functionality required to fulfill the request.
Server Error: Bad Gateway. The server, while acting as a gateway or proxy, received an invalid response from an upstream server.
Server Error: Service Unavailable. The server is currently unable to handle the request due to temporary overloading or maintenance.
Server Error: Gateway Timeout. The server, while acting as a gateway or proxy, did not receive a timely response from an upstream server.
Server Error: HTTP Version Not Supported. The server does not support the major version of HTTP used in the request.
